# Bayes FC

> Team ratings from the betting market: daily attack, defence, and overall strength ratings for Europe's top football clubs, derived from closing betting-market prices and rebuilt every day.

## Ratings

- [Global cross-league ladder](https://bayesfc.com/): A cross-league ladder placing every European club on one comparable strength scale, rebuilt daily from betting-market closing prices.
- [League ladders](https://bayesfc.com/leagues.html): Daily attack, defence, and overall strength ratings for every club in Europe's top football leagues, derived from closing betting-market prices and comparable within each league.
- [Club pages](https://bayesfc.com/club/): one page per rated club — its rating over time, recent results, upcoming fixtures and season projection (132 clubs).

## Questions

- [Who is the strongest team in Europe?](https://bayesfc.com/strongest-team-in-europe/): As of 23 September 2026, the market rates Arsenal the strongest club in Europe, ahead of Manchester City and Barcelona.
- [Which is the strongest league in Europe?](https://bayesfc.com/strongest-league-in-europe/): As of 23 September 2026, the Premier League is the strongest league in Europe by the average rating of its clubs, ahead of La Liga and Ligue 1.
- [Who will win the Premier League this season?](https://bayesfc.com/premier-league/title-race/): As of 23 September 2026, Manchester City is the most likely Premier League champion at 50%, ahead of Arsenal (45%) and Liverpool (3%).
- [Who is the strongest team in the Premier League?](https://bayesfc.com/premier-league/strongest-team/): As of 23 September 2026, the market rates Arsenal the strongest side in the Premier League, ahead of Manchester City and Liverpool.
- [Who will be relegated from the Premier League this season?](https://bayesfc.com/premier-league/relegation/): As of 23 September 2026, Hull is the most likely to be relegated from the Premier League at 75%, ahead of Coventry (73%) and Ipswich (41%).

- [Who is the strongest team in La Liga?](https://bayesfc.com/la-liga/strongest-team/): As of 23 September 2026, the market rates Barcelona the strongest side in La Liga, ahead of Real Madrid and Atletico Madrid.

- [Who will win Serie A this season?](https://bayesfc.com/serie-a/title-race/): As of 23 September 2026, Inter is the most likely Serie A champion at 59%, ahead of Roma (16%) and Juventus (11%).

- [Who will win the Bundesliga this season?](https://bayesfc.com/bundesliga/title-race/): As of 23 September 2026, Bayern Munich is the most likely Bundesliga champion at 97%, ahead of Dortmund (2%) and Leverkusen (–).

## Writing

- [Who got the easy start? First five games in England, Spain and Germany](https://bayesfc.com/blog/fixture-difficulty-opening-five.html): Every club's first five league games in the Premier League, La Liga and the Bundesliga, ranked from the hardest opening to the easiest.
- [What a wage bill buys](https://bayesfc.com/blog/what-a-wage-bill-buys.html): Across Europe's top seven leagues, pay explains most of team strength — but the clubs off the line are the interesting ones.
- [How we turn betting odds into team strength](https://bayesfc.com/blog/how-we-turn-betting-odds-into-team-strength.html): Why betting odds tell you more about a team than results or xG — and how we read team strength straight out of them.
